newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Spain to hold next techno Expo in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Spain to hold next techno Expo in Brazil.

text.p: Madrid will hold an Industrial and Technological Fair in Brazil, hoping to boost trade with what it sees as "the great economic potential" of Latin America, a top Spanish Economics Ministry official said on Friday.

Jose Manuel Fernandez Norniella, Secretary of State for Trade, Tourism and Smaller Companies, told reporters in Brasilia that Madrid hoped the Expo would lay the groundwork for up to 257 Spanish firms to enter the Brazilian market.
"Holding the fair in Brazil is a sign of our confidence in the future of this country," he said.
The technological trade fair will be held in Brazil's industrial city of Sao Paulo between December 22-27 and more than 400 Spanish firms are expected to attend.
